name: Cleanvoice
tagline: Cleanvoice is an AI audio editing tool that automatically removes filler words (um, uh, like), mouth sounds, stutters, and dead silence from podcast and video recordings. Editors upload a file and Cleanvoice returns a cleaned version in minutes, eliminating hours of manual editing. It handles multiple languages and accents, and offers a timeline view for reviewing and approving each edit before export. Podcasters and video creators use it to cut post-production time dramatically without the cost of a professional audio editor.
